column1: And before you pay for any A.I., ask the same question in your own language to two or three of them.
Chat G.P.T., DeepSeek, and an Indian one, like Sarvam's app, called Indus.
Pay only for the one that really understands you.
And A.I. isn't the only thing India has built for itself.
Did you know India has its own satellite navigation, up in space?
So why does your phone still lean on America's G.P.S.?
Before you go, try this tonight.
Ask any A.I. one question in your mother tongue... and tell me in the comments which one answered best.
This is Be Practical with Kishore.
